data.headline: After a hard effort, how fast does your heart come back down?
data.text: A big study followed people through a treadmill test.

data.headline: The first minute after you stop is a clue.
data.text: Heart rate falls fast, then more slowly.

data.headline: A slow drop went with more health trouble later.
data.text: A link, not a cause. Not a fitness test for you.

data.headline: Coming down after effort is a skill you can practise.
data.text: We move, then we practise coming down, with breath, on purpose.

data.headline: Calm is something we can train.
data.text: Slow breath out. Let the shoulders drop.

data.headline: Push hard but struggle to settle afterwards?
data.text: Comment COMEDOWN and we will help you start.
data.note: Cole et al., NEJM, 1999. Link, not cause. If something feels off during or after exercise, see a doctor first.
